value.rationale: The original computational model motivates whether positive and negative camps can coexist indefinitely. The theorem proves for all network sizes that the physically sampled amplitude randomness yields almost-sure finite-time sign absorption with an explicit exponential tail and subsequent exact extremism velocity; a deterministic amplitude specialization instead has parity-restricted persistent sign cycles. This is a structural noise-versus-recurrence distinction, not a routine graph census or a short finite simulation. Scope is strictly delimited to complete, strongly receptive all-amplifier populations.
